name: Asia Financial Holdings Limited
summary: Asia Financial Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in provision of underwriting of general and life insurance in Hong Kong, Macau, and Mainland China. The company operates in two segments, Insurance and Corporate. It is involved in securities trading, holding, and other businesses; and providing nominee, and health care services. The company also engages in the property investment activities. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. Asia Financial Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Claremont Capital Holdings Ltd.
